P002 — Inconsistent archimedean, local-density and intermediate symmetric-case factors — Counterevidence: The corrected local arithmetic and final class-weighted average agree. The direct n=4 computation validates the 2-adic densities and the factor 7/8. The weaker rank-three error still tends to zero and is sufficient for the final prime sums. No falsity of the headline symmetric determinant prime asymptotic is established by these local discrepancies.

Limits: This is a local count, not a new proof of the homogeneous-dynamics equidistribution theorem or an unconditional certification of the global theorem. It concerns the integer matrix lattice with the usual coordinate volume.
Limits: Conditional on the cited level-set equidistribution theorem and ordinary PNT. No fresh proof or external validation of Oh's theorem is claimed.

Counterevidence: The ambient dimension and general density definition determine an explicit correction. Together with the dimensionally correct p13 weighted prime sum, this supports interpreting the denominator as a local copied formula error rather than evidence that the final Pfaffian asymptotic is false.

Limits: The full general-n finite-field count attributed to MacWilliams and the external Pfaffian Linnik theorem were read as citations only, not fetched or independently reproved. Over characteristic two, the check uses the base change of the integral alternating lattice (zero diagonal), not the larger set obtained by imposing only A^T=-A over F_2.
Limits: No extension to negative-prime counts is inferred solely from this positive-level computation.
Counterevidence: The required o(1) stability and weighted prime sums survive the weaker error. No final symmetric-matrix prime-counting theorem is refuted by this discrepancy.

Counterevidence: The actual rank-four count supports equation (18)'s plus sign and plus denominator. It contradicts the literal minus-sign branch in the statement of Proposition 7.4, while supporting the corrected constants used in the final averaging.
Limits: This is a direct proof and exact computation for n=4 at the place 2. It is not an independent proof of all-rank local genus classification, mass formulas or global equidistribution.

Limits: This checks multiplication and cancellation of the displayed class-number and measure formulas. It does not certify EMMV genus equidistribution, Kitaoka's theorem, their precise quoted hypotheses, the all-rank mass calculation, or Zhang/DRS absolute measure normalization.
Limits: All manuscript text read, but detailed verification only C0388-A through C0388-D.
Limits: No complete independent reproof of Eskin-Oh/Oh/Ratner equidistribution, Borovoi-Rudnick measure conventions, or MacWilliams' general finite-field formula.
Limits: Ordinary PNT is an explicitly external standard input; this review does not presume the multivariate prime asymptotic it is checking.
Limits: No assertion of journal-version identity, final acceptance, or completion of the full paper review.
Limits: Oh's indefinite-orbit equidistribution and adelic delta formula, including precise hypotheses.
Limits: All-rank p-adic genus/orbit classification and Hasse matching; only the finite n=4, place-2 density was independently checked here.
Limits: Siegel's mass formula and Conway-Sloane/Kitaoka local density formulas as external results; the rank-three finding is an internal substitution in the formulas printed in this manuscript.
